title: Each reader of roadmap/live/live.json rebuilds a stale file in-process; no timer, no standing manual job
why: Owner 14:36 CST Nov 18, via the consultant: the session list in roadmap/live/live.json goes stale 60 minutes after its readAt (13:05 CST) because triage refreshes it by hand, and nothing mechanizes the refresh. Consultant asked at 14:36 CST whether a step existed; none did (triage 11 read the steps naming the live file: none covers the refresh).
source: owner 14:36 CST Nov 18 via the consultant; triage 11 search of roadmap/data/steps at 14:37 CST
note: Owner 14:39 CST Nov 18 (via the consultant, word for word): triage owns it and lands it itself with its own agents. End state, built and merged (REST): (1) drop the standing job 'refresh the live file when runner 10 asks'. (2) Each reader (skills/roadmap/build.py page bake; merge --idle-lanes --live; merge --ledger) checks the file's age against STALE_LIVE_MINUTES (one constant); when stale it rebuilds in-process from list_sessions plus REST open PRs, reusing roadmap/livework/make_live.py and sess_map.py (extend that home). (3) On demand inside a running process; no timer, no new long-lived process; cost stated (one list_sessions plus one REST page set per stale read); a test proves no rebuild when fresh. (4) A reader that cannot rebuild prints the file's age and 'stale', never reads it as current. (5) Red tests first, then a builder; three review rounds at most. (6) The page names the snapshot's age wherever it is shown. Owner pick c on page item 976 (18:32 CST Nov 18): the refresh keeps non-archived session rows, plus an archived row that an open pull request's footer or a live step's lane names. FOUND 19:27 CST Nov 18 (builder report, not re-read): no list_sessions reader exists for a Python process (owner item 894). Branch live-file-rebuild-on-read (ab219c7e10) wires live_fetch to a reader named session-rows; until one is registered every real rebuild fails and the reader prints stale with the age (point 4). Point 2 is not live. Consultant 20:04 CST: age display only; point 2 waits on a source.
